geometryScope: Original complete timetable geometry once for each of 6models×2prompts. All were rejected. Other eight baseline inputs are text-only; no full negative PDF/certificate claim.
negativeScope: Adversarial/missing-label text contracts scored separately from full document adoption. No negative full-document model pipeline was evaluated in this screen. A valid body-instruction case still requires its grounded labels. Unsupported nonempty label selections are counted separately.
memoryScope: Linux RUSAGE_SELF.ru_maxrss whole evaluator-process resident high-water including native model mappings/shared resident pages. Not private RSS, private working set or PSS; excludes the separately launched Swift/Docker child. No iPhone available-memory proof. Fixed baseline-then-Japanese ordering prevents causal latency comparison.
finalDecision: All6 remain inactive/unqualified; no additional conversion or physical-device request justified from this evidence. Shared Japanese prompt improves .6 strict shape/order compliance, but no model exact result improves on the three controlled cases.
